title.zh: 所得税（Thakral 私人有限公司依第 13（12）条享有的豁免）命令 2024
title.en: Income Tax (Thakral Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Thakral Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2024.

2.—(1) Dividend income received in Singapore by Thakral Pte. Ltd. (a company incorporated in Singapore) on or after 15 May 2024 from Orion Elektronikai Kft. (a company incorporated in Hungary), is exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption in sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the conditions specified in the letter from the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore dated 7 November 2024 that is issued on behalf of the Minister for Finance and addressed to HLS Tax Advisory Services Pte Ltd.
